title: Robust Repulsion for Growing Crowns in Linear Hypergraphs
summary: Put $q=r-1$, $t=k-1$, and $D=tq+1$. For an edge $e$ of a linear $C^r_{1,k}$-free $r$-uniform hypergraph, define \[ δ_H(e)=\sum_{v\in e}\frac{1}{d_H(v)}-\frac{r}{D}. \] The defect satisfies $δ_H(e)\ge 0$. At equality, every vertex of $e$ has degree $D$, and the petal trace at $e$ is a disjoint union of $t$ affine planes of order $q$. Equivalently, restoring the base line gives $t$ projective planes of order $q$ with common line $e$. For growing crowns, the equality structure is stable in the following sense.
